ex.en: The two parties formed a coalition after neither won a clear majority.
ex.zh: 两党在均未赢得明显多数后组成联盟。

words.note: coalition 指政党为共同目的结成的临时同盟，常搭配 form。

ex.en: It is risky to generalize from a single case to the whole population.
ex.zh: 仅凭单个案例推断整个群体是有风险的。

words.note: generalize from 表归纳来源，generalize about 表泛论。

ex.en: Dust had accumulated on the shelves during the long holiday.
ex.zh: 长假期间书架上积了一层灰。

words.note: accumulate 强调逐渐积累，可及物也可不及物。

ex.en: The police are investigating a series of crimes in the neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 警方正在调查该社区发生的一系列案件。

words.note: commit a crime 为固定搭配；crime rate 指犯罪率。

ex.en: The new tower dwarfs every other building in the city centre.
ex.zh: 这座新塔楼使市中心的其它建筑都相形见绌。

words.note: dwarf 作动词表“使相形见绌”，常用 be dwarfed by。

ex.en: She heaved the heavy suitcase onto the luggage rack.
ex.zh: 她使劲把沉重的行李箱抬上行李架。

words.note: heave 强调用力举起；heave a sigh 为叹气搭配。

ex.en: Many people spend their leisure time watching short videos on their phones.
ex.zh: 许多人把空闲时间花在手机上看短视频。

words.note: at leisure 意为“有空时、从容地”；leisure time 指空闲时间。

ex.en: Fresh vegetables and whole grains nourish the body and support the immune system.
ex.zh: 新鲜蔬菜和全谷物滋养身体并支持免疫系统。

words.note: nourish 本义“滋养”，引申为“怀有（希望）”。

ex.en: Grease the pan lightly before you pour in the batter.
ex.zh: 倒入面糊前先给平底锅抹一层薄油。

words.note: grease 作名词指油脂，作动词指给…涂油。

ex.en: The company is alleged to have hidden the safety report from regulators.
ex.zh: 该公司被指称向监管机构隐瞒了安全报告。

words.note: allege 常用被动 be alleged to do，语气正式而带不确定。

ex.en: Every spring thousands of pilgrims walk to the mountain temple.
ex.zh: 每年春天都有成千上万的朝圣者步行前往山中寺庙。

words.note: pilgrim 指朝圣者，其朝圣之旅为 pilgrimage。

ex.en: The new policy triggered a wave of protests across the country.
ex.zh: 新政策在全国引发了抗议浪潮。

words.note: trigger 作动词表“引发”，常接 reaction、debate。

ex.en: Children usually assimilate a new language faster than adults do.
ex.zh: 儿童通常比成人更快地吸收一门新语言。

words.note: assimilate 指吸收知识或被同化，融入用 assimilate into。

ex.en: She kept a positive attitude even when the project ran into trouble.
ex.zh: 即使项目遇到困难，她仍保持积极的态度。

words.note: positive 表“积极的、肯定的”，反义词 negative。

ex.en: The school was accused of segregating students with disabilities from their peers.
ex.zh: 这所学校被指责把残障学生与同学隔离开来。

words.note: segregate 常与 from 连用，指按种族等强行分开。

ex.en: He became a video game addict in his first year at university.
ex.zh: 上大学的头一年他就成了电子游戏成瘾者。

words.note: addict 作名词重音在前；be addicted to 中 to 为介词。

ex.en: Graduates with strong digital skills have better job prospects this year.
ex.zh: 掌握扎实数字技能的毕业生今年就业前景更好。

words.note: prospect 表“前景”常用复数 prospects。

ex.en: The witness was accused of withholding key information from the court.
ex.zh: 该证人被指控向法庭隐瞒关键信息。

words.note: withhold 强调故意不给，常接 information、payment。

ex.en: The two cities are comparable in size but very different in culture.
ex.zh: 这两座城市规模相当，但文化差异很大。

words.note: comparable to 表“比得上”，with 表“可作比较”。

ex.en: She was very discreet about her friend's private affairs.
ex.zh: 她对朋友的私事非常谨慎，不随便谈论。

words.note: discreet 是“谨慎的”；discrete 是“分离的、离散的”。

ex.en: She specializes in international trade law at a large firm.
ex.zh: 她在一家大型律所专攻国际贸易法。

words.note: specialize 后固定接 in，不接 on。

ex.en: For instance, many students study late at night before an exam.
ex.zh: 例如，许多学生在考试前熬夜学习。

words.note: for instance 与 for example 同义，也指“实例”。

ex.en: The meeting was cancelled, presumably because the manager was ill.
ex.zh: 会议取消了，大概是因为经理生病了。

words.note: presumably 表“据推测”，强调推断有依据。

ex.en: Employees received a generous bonus for meeting their sales targets.
ex.zh: 员工因完成销售指标而获得丰厚的奖金。

words.note: bonus 指工资外的奖金，复数为 bonuses。

ex.en: The scientist finally gained international recognition for her research.
ex.zh: 这位科学家的研究最终获得了国际认可。

words.note: in recognition of 意为“为表彰”，另有“认出”义。

ex.en: The hotel prepared a grand banquet for the visiting delegation.
ex.zh: 酒店为来访代表团准备了盛大的宴会。

words.note: banquet 指正式大型宴会，比 dinner 隆重。

ex.en: The children were thrilled to see the pandas at the zoo.
ex.zh: 孩子们在动物园看到熊猫非常兴奋。

words.note: thrill 作动词常用被动 be thrilled to do，名词指兴奋感。

ex.en: I always book an aisle seat so that I can stretch my legs.
ex.zh: 我总是订靠过道的座位，好伸展双腿。

words.note: aisle 中 s 不发音；座位分 aisle seat 与 window seat。

ex.en: The chairman convened an emergency meeting to discuss the crisis.
ex.zh: 主席召开紧急会议讨论这场危机。

words.note: convene 可及物表“召集”，也可不及物表“开会”。

ex.en: All the travel arrangements were made well before the conference began.
ex.zh: 所有出行安排都在会议开始前就做好了。

words.note: 表“安排”常用复数 arrangements，搭配 for。
